invariants: PAI mode is internal and never forces visible protocol text.
Ambiguous main-agent work fails safe to ALGORITHM.
Delegated work defaults to NATIVE unless it carries an explicit ALGORITHM marker.
Complex work uses native OMP progress state and focused skills.
OMP AbortSignal is propagated into Action, Flow, and Pipeline execution.
TELOS and MEMORY are loaded only on demand.
